atoms.a: Which things are not used in formal speech and writing?
Which things are often used in formal speech and writing?

instruction.text: Find all the sentences that make the text an informal piece of writing.

atoms.b: The King’s coronation was fast approaching. ((How exciting!)) Buckingham Palace had requested that all schools across the country celebrate this historic event. ((They’d sent out flags and decorations to every primary school.)) This was to help the children feel patriotic and embrace the exciting change. ((Primary schools all over the place baked cakes and had large celebrations.)) ((It was well cool!)) ((The King couldn’t wait for the big day.)) ((It was defo not a day to be missed.))

instruction.text: Write out the contractions in full to make the text more formal.

atoms.b: The King’s coronation was fast approaching. How exciting! Buckingham Palace had requested that all schools across the country celebrate this historic event. ((They_had)) sent out flags and decorations to every primary school. This was to help the children feel patriotic and embrace the exciting change. Primary schools all over the place baked cakes and had large celebrations. It was well cool! The King ((could_not)) wait for the big day. It was defo not a day to be missed.

instruction.text: Replace the exclamatory sentences to make the text more formal.

atoms.b: The King’s coronation was fast approaching. ((++It_was_an_exciting_time. It_was_proper_exciting.)) Buckingham Palace had requested that all schools across the country celebrate this historic event. They had sent out flags and decorations to every primary school. This was to help the children feel patriotic and embrace the exciting change. Primary schools all over the place baked cakes and had large celebrations. ((++It_was_an_important_day_in_history. It_was_pretty_important,_right?)) The King could not wait for the big day. It was defo not a day to be missed.

instruction.text: Replace the informal language to make the text more formal.

atoms.b: The King’s coronation was fast approaching. It was an exciting time. Buckingham Palace had requested that all schools across the country celebrate this historic event. They had sent out flags and decorations to every primary school. This was to help the children feel patriotic and embrace the exciting change. Primary schools ((++nationwide here_and_there)) baked cakes and had large celebrations. It was an important day in history. The King could not wait for the big day. It was ((++definitely for_sure)) not a day to be missed.
